correctness.rationale: Independent proof: p-morphism back makes each source equivalence class surject onto its unique image class; idempotence fixes image points and thus whole target classes; satellites are independent onto maps. Twice applying the labelled SET construction yields the formal EGF. Exact checker enumerates all partitions through five worlds and all functions and independently compares truncated EGF coefficients through seven; finite tests support but are not the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: No verified covering census for idempotent bounded morphisms across all finite labelled S5 frames. Prior partition-preserving-idempotent results are stronger for the underlying unstructured maps, and closely overlap the decompositional proof, but count all maps rather than the back-condition-constrained species. The double labelled SET-of-rooted-satellites generating function, exact all-size counts and image-class-size obstruction are not stated by those sources. This is a qualified best-knowledge assessment, not exhaustive priority proof.
residual_risks: 2015 nonuniform partition-preserving idempotent enumeration is very close. An unlocated direct or routine specialized surjection-filtered census could predate this result.
Search and access do not establish global uniqueness or historical priority.

value.rationale: The variable-size all-labelled count across every finite equivalence-frame relation is a natural exact invariant of finite modal quotient theory, not an arbitrary narrow slice; it measures the number of idempotent p-morphism certificates, naturally different from ordinary partition-homomorphism counts. A closed two-level EGF for the whole class, complete fixed-frame refinement and minimum-block image obstruction are structurally interpretable and answer the concrete full enumeration question. No novelty-only or code-only value claim.
